subject.title: Proof stack for generated media wake-false fallback

question: Should this proof-only stack remain open for another Mantis/live proof attempt, or should maintainers close it in favor of the split implementation and harness PRs?
rationale: The branch is intentionally a temporary proof target, and the available live artifact did not start the scenario, so automation cannot decide whether the missing proof is acceptable or whether the stack has served its purpose.

options.title: Rerun Or Fix The Proof Target
options.body: Keep this draft open until a redacted Telegram Desktop artifact, terminal live output, or logs show main missing/blocking the marker image and the candidate delivering exactly one generated image.

options.title: Accept The Combined Boundary
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally merge the stack as one combined implementation and proof-harness change while owning the delivery and automation coupling risk.

options.title: Close In Favor Of Split PRs
options.body: If the proof runner cannot exercise this scenario or the split PRs become sufficient, close this draft and keep review focused on the separate implementation and harness PRs.

recommendation.title: Rerun Or Fix The Proof Target
recommendation.body: Keep this draft open until a redacted Telegram Desktop artifact, terminal live output, or logs show main missing/blocking the marker image and the candidate delivering exactly one generated image.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved decision is primarily about Telegram/Mantis proof execution, and recent history shows this handle on the relevant proof-runner path.
